title.zh: 美CFTC主席：将推进加密交易平台自愿联邦注册机制
title.en: 美CFTC主席：将推进加密交易平台自愿联邦注册机制

current_state.zh: CFTC Chairman Mike Selig said the agency is moving ahead with a voluntary federal registration mechanism for crypto trading platforms, aiming to extend the same protections long applied to US derivatives markets while Congress remains inactive.
current_state.en: CFTC Chairman Mike Selig said the agency is moving ahead with a voluntary federal registration mechanism for crypto trading platforms, aiming to extend the same protections long applied to US derivatives markets while Congress remains inactive.
